presets.name: Golden cross: SMA20 crossed above SMA50
presets.desc: Short-term average just overtook the longer-term one - classic trend-change signal.

presets.name: Death cross: SMA20 crossed below SMA50
presets.desc: Momentum turning bearish on the daily chart.

presets.name: Uptrend with momentum (price > SMA50, RSI > 60)
presets.desc: Coins holding above their 50-day trend while momentum stays strong.

presets.name: RSI oversold (RSI14 < 30)
presets.desc: Short-term selling may be overdone.

presets.name: RSI overbought (RSI14 > 70)
presets.desc: Runaway momentum - watch for exhaustion.

presets.name: MACD bullish crossover today
presets.desc: MACD line just broke above its signal line.

presets.name: MACD positive in an uptrend
presets.desc: Bullish momentum confirmed by price structure.

presets.name: Stochastic oversold (%K < 20)
presets.desc: Price closing near the bottom of its recent range.

presets.name: Money flow oversold (MFI14 < 20)
presets.desc: Volume-weighted oversold reading.

presets.name: Volume surge (3x 20-bar average)
presets.desc: Unusual participation - often precedes a breakout.

presets.name: At a 52-week high
presets.desc: Price printing a fresh yearly high.

presets.name: Within 10% of a 52-week low
presets.desc: Deep in the range - potential mean-reversion candidate.

presets.name: 20-bar breakout
presets.desc: Close above the prior 20-bar high.

presets.name: Supertrend bullish with ADX > 25
presets.desc: Confirmed uptrend with a strong trend-strength reading.

presets.name: Strong trend (ADX > 30)
presets.desc: Directional move with real strength behind it.

presets.name: Bollinger squeeze (bandwidth < 4)
presets.desc: Volatility compressed - breakout usually follows.

presets.name: Tagging the lower Bollinger band (%B < 5)
presets.desc: Price sitting on the bottom band.

presets.name: High volatility (ATR > 5% of price)
presets.desc: Wide daily ranges - room for big swings.

presets.name: Top movers: up more than 5%
presets.desc: Strong single-bar gains.

presets.name: Liquid large caps (24h volume > $100M)
presets.desc: Majors with real depth behind them.

presets.name: Reversal candidate
presets.desc: Trend flipped up and momentum is positive but not yet stretched.
